max_reads.description: Scan at most this many records (0 scans the whole file).

min_overlap.description: Adapter prefix length that must match the read.

max_mismatches.description: Allowed substitutions inside the matched adapter prefix.

adapters.description: Optional comma-separated name:SEQUENCE panel; empty uses Illumina, Nextera and small-RNA adapters.

output.description: Output port name; defaults to the operator name.
